# satisfactory Provider

Manage Satisfactory factories through the SatisfactoryTerraform mod's HTTP API.

The provider assigns each resource a UUID (`tf_id`) and talks to the companion
[SatisfactoryTerraform](https://github.com/daroco/SatisfactoryTerraform) mod's
localhost REST API. The mod keeps a `tf_id → actor` registry persisted in the
save game, so `terraform plan` stays clean across save/load and in-game
dismantling surfaces as drift.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "satisfactory" {
  # Base URL of the mod's localhost API. Optional; defaults to the
  # SATISFACTORY_ENDPOINT env var, then http://localhost:8090.
  endpoint = "http://localhost:8090"

  # Bearer token, only needed when the mod is configured with one (for
  # non-loopback / dedicated-server setups). Optional; defaults to the
  # SATISFACTORY_TOKEN env var. Prefer the env var over hardcoding it.
  # token = var.satisfactory_token
}

# Show every placement a plan would make as a hologram in the running game,
# and surface the game's placement verdict as plan warnings. Off by default;
# also settable with SATISFACTORY_PREVIEW=1.
# preview = true
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the mod API. Defaults to SATISFACTORY_ENDPOINT or http://localhost:8090.
- `preview` (Boolean) Show every placement a plan would create as a hologram in the running game, and report the game's placement verdict (clearance, overlap, node snapping) as plan warnings. Holograms are transient: nothing is built or saved, and each one is removed when its building is applied or after a short timeout. Off by default because plan is meant to have no side effects. Defaults to the SATISFACTORY_PREVIEW env var ("1"/"true").
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token, required only when the mod is configured with one (set SATISFACTORY_TOKEN in the game's environment for non-loopback deployments). Defaults to the SATISFACTORY_TOKEN env var.
